headline: Public access building remediation tabled while a firm surveys the building for repairs.
summary: A mouse problem must be fixed before the public access program can restart, staff said. Two bids came in for the work, and one estimate put an outside building survey at $7,500 to $10,000. The skating rink window replacement, with a $7,183 bid, was also discussed.
decisions: Tabled the public access building remediation to a later meeting and let Jeff work with Weston and Sampson on a proposal and building survey. Vote was unanimous.
discussion: Public access building: Members wanted cost data before spending on repairs, and speakers asked that the cable committee review the memo first.
Franchise fee funds: Staff said hundreds of thousands of dollars in franchise fees meant for the program went to the general fund over five years.
Skating rink windows: Eight plexiglass windows would be replaced with tempered glass, and a $7,183 bid from Carl Goodwin was moved for approval.
Facilities staffing: Speakers urged a facilities manager and an in-house maintenance crew, saying outside contractors cost more.

decision_evidence.quote: I'd like to make a motion to roll the 5A public at building access building remediation over into a subsequent meeting and allow Jeff to work with Wes and Samson, get a proposal, and walk the building into a survey. ... All right. All those in favor? All right. Unanimous.
